errors.text: The proposed precipitation-aging treatment does not reconstruct the target HEBM-plus-SPS intervention or its nanocrystalline FCC/BCC strengthening mechanism.
No supporting prior evidence is cited despite the explicit request for it.
A carbide precipitate is suggested even though no carbon source or carbon-containing starting composition is specified.
The claimed retention of ductility and machinability is unsupported and conflicts with the target result, which showed intergranular fracture and limited ductility.
